summary: UI/UX polish this turn verified end-to-end on web + mobile smoke + backend regression. Statement Decoder & Invoice Detail donuts are fully visible on solid teal/clay panels with contrasting mint/gold/coral/sage segments; donut + legend rows are clickable and smooth-scroll to the anomaly/issue register (money donut scrollY 0->1433, severity donut scrollY 0->1433). SmartAISummary (Wayly Summary on statement detail) is the solid teal gradient panel with near-white body text. DecoderResultView 3 download buttons have visibly different backgrounds (share=teal rgb(14,77,82), CSV=sage rgb(66,95,71), PDF=clay rgb(165,81,43)); decoder-who-paid-legend shows Government 95% + You paid 5%; decoder-balance-panel renders as solid sage panel. PageIntro eyebrow removed on tool pages (page-intro renders without pageintro-eyebrow). ParticipantProfile core1-timeline-section is a native <details> element and collapse/expand works. PersonaToggle active bg = teal for caregiver (rgb(14,77,82)), clay for participant (rgb(165,81,43)). Premium button hover on pricing tier-cta deepens (bg 14,77,82 -> 9,29,51), translateY(-1px), deep shadow; landing final-cta-signup also lifts translateY(-2px) with deeper shadow. Pricing Family tier: RECOMMENDED badge fully visible, $49.50 in white. Mobile Expo preview loads Wayly login screen cleanly. Backend /auth/me access_state fixtures: cathy=active, trialactive=trial, cancelled.vo=view_only — 3/3 PASS.

issues: 'Wayly Summary' card on the invoice detail page renders as a plain white/outline card (inline JSX at InvoiceDetail.jsx:209), not the new solid-teal-gradient SmartAISummary panel used on statement detail/dashboard. Not called out in the review spec, but this is now visually inconsistent with the same 'Wayly Summary' label elsewhere. Consider swapping to <SmartAISummary/> for parity.

React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — appears to be from an editor runtime probe injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Not caused by this turn's changes, but pollutes console.

action_items: (Optional) Replace the inline 'Wayly Summary' card in /app/frontend/src/pages/InvoiceDetail.jsx around line 209 with <SmartAISummary/> so the solid teal gradient + near-white text style matches statement detail/dashboard.

(Optional) Root-cause the <span>-in-<option> hydration warning from the runtime wrapper on pages with <select> (BudgetScenarios.jsx line 279+) if it is coming from app code and not the editor runtime probe.
critical_code_review_comments: PageIntro (components/PageIntro.jsx) uses a single data-testid='page-intro' for the whole header; the 3 inner cards (What/How/What you get) are just class-based (sect-teal/clay/sage) with no per-card testid. If future turns need to assert individual card visibility/colour, add data-testid='pageintro-card-what|how|get'.
StatementInsightGraphics & InvoiceInsightGraphics duplicate a scrollToFirst helper — extract to a shared util (~10 lines duplicated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: This turn's UI polish (premium buttons, SmartAISummary solid teal, Statement/Invoice donut visibility + click-to-scroll, DecoderResultView 3-colour download buttons, PageIntro no-eyebrow + solid brand cards, ParticipantProfile Timeline as <details>, PersonaToggle teal/clay, Pricing Family RECOMMENDED + white price, DualFlagshipHero final-cta-signup premium) all verified on preview host https://wayly-engagement-hub.preview.emergentagent.com.
